text:
*Star Trek: The Motion Picture* is set in the 23rd century when a Starfleet monitoring station, Epsilon Nine, detects an alien entity moving toward Earth, which destroys several Klingon warships and Epsilon Nine. The starship Enterprise is assigned to intercept this cloud entity. After testing new systems goes poorly, Commander Spock joins the crew, sensing a consciousness emanating from the cloud.
Enterprise intercepts the entity, which turns out to be V'Ger, a sentient, non-biological machine that originated from a 20th-century NASA Voyager 6 probe. V'Ger, having gathered immense knowledge, demands the "Creator" appear to complete its sequence. Commander Willard Decker offers himself to V'Ger, merging with the probe, which results in the creation of a new life form and saves Earth.
